WITH equip_avg_humidity AS (
  SELECT 
    e.equipregistry,
    AVG(se.humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON e.equipregistry = se.equipref
    AND se.humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY e.equipregistry
),
all_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(se.humepct) as overall_avg
  FROM scanenvironment se
  WHERE se.humepct IS NOT NULL
),
above_avg_equip AS (
  SELECT eah.equipregistry, eah.avg_humidity
  FROM equip_avg_humidity eah
  CROSS JOIN all_avg aa
  WHERE eah.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND aa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND eah.avg_humidity > aa.overall_avg
),
group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as group_mean
  FROM above_avg_equip
)
SELECT 
  aae.equipregistry,
  aae.avg_humidity,
  aae.avg_humidity - aa.overall_avg as exceeds_all_avg,
  aae.avg_humidity - gm.group_mean as exceeds_group_mean
FROM above_avg_equip aae
CROSS JOIN all_avg aa
CROSS JOIN group_mean gm
ORDER BY exceeds_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
